README air-coin script (board 4): score 10->20 between ticks 110 and 115 with the ball at x 2.03, y 0.93 in flight, coin (2.2,1.2,0) gone. README clear script (570 ticks): tick 569 screen won, score 30, lives 1, texts include 'You win'; unchanged at 700.

Settings: menu_right on Language gives en->es->fr (left back fr->es->en); language fr in the state. Settings texts: Volume, Language, Ball: Normal, Back in that order (Ball focused after Language, Back after Ball). menu_left Normal->Light, menu_right ->Normal->Heavy (Heavy stays at Heavy). Shown as Bola: Normal / Balle : Normale / Legere / Lourde in es/fr. ball_kind becomes heavy/light in play one tick after Start (see defects: it lags on the menu screens).

board=2, script 0:enter,60:right,120:none, settings folders light/normal/heavy, --at every 2 ticks: ball x identical to 4 decimals up to tick 130; at tick 134 (before the first crate moves at 136) x -0.486/-0.482/-0.477 (within 0.01). Sum of six crate displacements at tick 256: light 0.459, normal 2.298, heavy 4.736.

One run set volume 6, French, Light into a folder (settings.json has volume, language, ball); a second run with it starts volume 6, fr, Balle : Legere, ball_kind light in play. A hand-written old-style settings.json with only volume 3 and es loads: Volumen: 3, Espanol, Bola: Normal, ball_kind normal.

Re-ran m01-m22 and m24: board 1 drop first <=0.3 at tick 27, bounces to 0.6, rests 0.25, 3 bounce sounds; pushes +x/-x/-z/+z keep moving 50 ticks after release; engine-found script clears board 1 -> board 2 at tick 516 (+10, clear, ball at start, 3 coins, 6 crates); crates within 0.0002 over 300 ticks; strike moves 2 crates >0.3, ball slowed (x -0.015 at tick 160 vs ~1.0 unobstructed); crate off edge removed; fall costs a life, keeps taken coins and crates, lives carried 1 into board 2; bridge_x 1,2,1,0 at 90/180/270/360; ball resting on bridge keeps offset within 0.11 over 340 ticks; push into the gap falls; board 3 script + board 4 script (offset 216) wins with score 60 and stays until enter -> title; lost freezes state, enter -> title; pause freezes ball/bridge/crates, Resume and Quit to title work; two identical board-2 runs byte-identical; 4 WAVs 0.25-0.9 s, non-silent, distinct; frames 800x480; Spanish complete on all screens; menus and volume 0..10 clamp; no-folder runs start 8/en.

f_b4.png (board 4, tick 60): PNG 800x480; shows the slab, the ramp as a lighter tilted slab with a visible edge, the blue ball at the left, and three yellow coins (the air coin drawn higher). After taking the first coin the frame shows two coins.

CHANGES.md lists each change with its files (lib.rs, fr.json, game.json setting, settings.json, strings), what was checked and how, and what was found wrong before (README folder path, fixed ball mass, no checks folder).

defects: ball_kind in the state lags the Ball setting: on the title and Settings screens it keeps the previous run's value (Settings shows Ball: Heavy while ball_kind is normal) and only changes one tick after a run starts.
README's line under the board-3 script still says it ends at screen won, score 30; it now ends on board 4 in play.
README's Files section names only en.json and es.json; fr.json is not listed.
The ramp is a tilted slab with open space under its high end: a ball rolled back from +x wedges under it and rests at x 1.06 (solid, but it gets stuck there).
The board-4 clearing script given in the README loses two lives on the way (allowed by the brief, but no lossless win is offered).

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
